S.FORM: pinshzyan na kinhakul sun maha kinhakul hya' ga, nanu' yani qu lalu' na gluw nqu kmayal maha ngasal qaniy. nma' sun maha kinhakul qani hya' ga, yalaw gi mnaki' squ sawn maha Hakul na qutux rhzyal, ru tmqalang kya lru yasa qu sawn naha' maha kinhakul kya la. maylipa' nanu' ki'aa bsyaq maki' kya lru mngaygyut hbazyaw qu squliq naha' lru, mnqsu' balay kahul kya musa' mshzi' hga, nanu' yaqu pzyux iyal qqnazi' ka babaw llyung qu ki'an naha', nanu' yasa qu sawn naha' maha Mqnazi' kya la. babaw niya lawzi khmay lawzi qu mnaki' kya Hakul ru mwah mshzi' lga, wal rima' ki'an na mqnazi' kwara' qu bblaq rhzyal ka babaw llyung lruw, siy usa' hmkangi' sa zayzil rgyax laha la, nanu' yasa qu sawn naha' maha maylipa' laha' la. Lkmbuta' nanu' babaw niya' khmay lawzi qu squliq naha' lruw, nanu' aring kya qu mrhuw naha' ka Lkmbuta' ki mintsawy' niya' ka Lkmyabuh ru Lkm'ayan cyugal naha' qu maras sa kinbahan naha musa' mgazyang sa nyux ta' ki'an misu qani la. nanu' qu kinbahan na Lkmbuta' hya' lga, nanu' zmyax squ quri' sqabu' lru, mwah hmkangi' squ mkura' tay suruw na Papak waqa' laha, nanu' mntta' sa b'bu'' Baykugan lga, 'lwan naha' kwara' kya qu aring tqzing ru Cinsbu', pngyan wagi', tunan, payhwan, nanu' musa' mqumah kya sa rrhzyal qani qu kinbahan na mqnazi, yalaw gi minkahul kya sa qnazi' mwah mshzi' sqaniy ru ini' naha' lxaniy qu lalu' naha' kya maha mqnazi' ruw yasa sisay mqnazi' laha hiya. Nanu' babaw niya' lga mwah squ skaru' qani lruw shngan kya na Gipun sqani laha' la. Lkmyabuh nanu' qu kinbahan ni Lkmyabuh hya' lga, wayal pgzyax kya squ tunux tawpuk laha, ruw wayal kya squ rhzyal sawn misuw qani ka Nango qasa, gluw naha' kya hya' lga wayal mgazyang kya squ Haga' paris, Ropuy, Kinyang, Kbabaw, Kulu' ru Rgyax. nanu' kwara' qu gluw na maylipa' ka nyuw mwah mshzi' sa rhzyal tay Gawgan qani hiya' lga, nanu' yaqu zmyax uzi squ quri' sqabu' lga, mkura' squ tmqszyap na suruw papak laha' lru mwah kya sa qrahu' hkawan ru msgagay kya lruw wayal tay balung kruma' wayal mkura' tay Hbun bilaqbilaq kruma', ruw wayal kya Gawgan kruma', aring kya mthuluy ruw mwah squ kwara' rhzyal na Sbtunux qani kwara' naha'. yalaw gi minkahul kya squ mlipa' ruw ini' naha' laxiy uzi qu lalu' naha' kya maha mlipa' ru yasa siy naha' rasiy kya uzi lalu' naha' maha Maylipa' la.

maħa ħakul na qutux rħzjal ru tmqalaŋ kja lru ja[s|ɕ]a qu [s|ɕ]awn naħaʔ maħa kinħakul kja la majlipaʔ nanuʔ kiʔaa β[s|ɕ]jaq makiʔ kja lru mŋajɣjut ħβazjaw qu [s|ɕ]quliq naħaʔ lru mnq[s|ɕ]uʔ βalaj kaħul kja mu[s|ɕ]aʔ m[s|ɕ]ħziʔ ħɣa nanuʔ jaqu pzjux ijal qqnaziʔ ka βaβaw lljuŋ qu kiʔan naħaʔ nanuʔ ja[s|ɕ]a qu [s|ɕ]awn naħaʔ maħa mqnaziʔ kja la βaβaw nija lawzi kħmaj lawzi qu mnakiʔ kja ħakul ru mwaħ m[s|ɕ]ħziʔ lɣa wal rimaʔ kiʔan na mqnaziʔ kwaraʔ qu ββlaq rħzjal ka βaβaw lljuŋ lruw [s|ɕ]ij u[s|ɕ]aʔ ħmkaŋiʔ [s|ɕ]a zajzil rɣjax laħa la nanuʔ ja[s|ɕ]a qu [s|ɕ]awn naħaʔ maħa majlipaʔ laħaʔ la lkmβutaʔ nanuʔ βaβaw nijaʔ kħmaj lawzi qu [s|ɕ]quliq naħaʔ lruw nanuʔ ariŋ kja qu mrħuw naħaʔ ka lkmβutaʔ ki mint[s|ɕ]awjʔ nijaʔ ka lkmjaβuħ ru lkmʔajan [ʦ|ʨ]juɣal naħaʔ qu mara[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]a kinβaħan naħa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ mɣazjaŋ [s|ɕ]a njux taʔ kiʔan mi[s|ɕ]u qani la nanuʔ qu kinβaħan na lkmβutaʔ ħjaʔ lɣa nanuʔ zmjax [s|ɕ]qu quriʔ [s|ɕ]qaβuʔ lru mwaħ ħmkaŋiʔ [s|ɕ]qu mkuraʔ taj [s|ɕ]uruw na papak waqaʔ laħa nanuʔ mnttaʔ [s|ɕ]a βʔβuʔʔ βajkuɣan lɣa ʔlwan naħaʔ kwaraʔ kja qu ariŋ tqziŋ ru [ʦ|ʨ]in[s|ɕ]βuʔ pŋjan waɣiʔ tunan pajħwan nanuʔ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ mqumaħ kja [s|ɕ]a rrħzjal qani qu kinβaħan na mqnazi jalaw ɣi minkaħul kja [s|ɕ]a qnaziʔ mwaħ m[s|ɕ]ħziʔ [s|ɕ]qanij ru iniʔ naħaʔ lxanij qu laluʔ naħaʔ kja maħa mqnaziʔ ruw ja[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]aj mqnaziʔ laħa ħija nanuʔ βaβaw nijaʔ lɣa mwaħ [s|ɕ]qu [s|ɕ]karuʔ qani lruw [s|ɕ]ħŋan kja na ɣipun [s|ɕ]qani laħaʔ la lkmjaβuħ nanuʔ qu kinβaħan ni lkmjaβuħ ħjaʔ lɣa wajal pɣzjax kja [s|ɕ]qu tunux tawpuk laħa ruw wajal kja [s|ɕ]qu rħzjal [s|ɕ]awn mi[s|ɕ]uw qani ka naŋo qa[s|ɕ]a ɣluw naħaʔ kja ħjaʔ lɣa wajal mɣazjaŋ kja [s|ɕ]qu ħaɣaʔ pari[s|ɕ] ropuj kinjaŋ kβaβaw kuluʔ ru rɣjax nanuʔ kwaraʔ qu ɣluw na majlipaʔ ka njuw mwaħ m[s|ɕ]ħziʔ [s|ɕ]a rħzjal taj ɣawɣan qani ħijaʔ lɣa nanuʔ jaqu zmjax uzi [s|ɕ]qu quriʔ [s|ɕ]qaβuʔ lɣa mkuraʔ [s|ɕ]qu tmq[s|ɕ]zjap na [s|ɕ]uruw papak laħaʔ lru mwaħ kja [s|ɕ]a qraħuʔ ħkawan ru m[s|ɕ]ɣaɣaj kja lruw wajal taj βaluŋ krumaʔ wajal mkuraʔ taj ħβun βilaqβilaq krumaʔ ruw wajal kja ɣawɣan krumaʔ ariŋ kja mtħuluj ruw mwaħ [s|ɕ]qu kwaraʔ rħzjal na [s|ɕ]βtunux qani kwaraʔ naħaʔ jalaw ɣi minkaħul kja [s|ɕ]qu mlipaʔ ruw iniʔ naħaʔ laxij uzi qu laluʔ naħaʔ kja maħa mlipaʔ ru ja[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]ij naħaʔ ra[s|ɕ]ij kja uzi laluʔ naħaʔ maħa majlipaʔ la
